name: brainstorming
title_zh: 新功能没想清楚先别动手，它会逼你把方案问到漏
tagline_zh: 定义模糊需求、架构选型、UI 设计、合同变更前，它像最较真的评审同事，逐条追问直到你发现漏洞；常规小请求不打扰。
tagline_en: For ambiguous or high-stakes design/architecture/contract decisions, it interrogates your plan like a ruthless.
desc_en: Use when defining ambiguous or high-complexity new features, product behavior, UI/component design, architecture choices, contract changes, or when grilling/pressure-testing a plan or design. Routine small requests stay on the fast path.
why_zh: 不是生成答案，而是用苏格拉底式连环追问帮你把隐藏假设和边界条件挖出来，压力测试你的设计。
why_en: It doesn't generate answers—it pressure-tests your thinking with relentless Socratic questioning, exposing hidden assumptions.
limit_zh: 只适用于高复杂度或模糊的新功能/设计/架构讨论；常规小请求它不介入。需要你已有初步想法或草案，纯空白起步它无从问起。
limit_en: Only for ambiguous/high-complexity new features, design, architecture, or contracts. Needs your rough draft to question; blank-slate brainstorming.
title_en: Before you build that vague feature, let it grill your.
